company.name: Cococart
company.shortDescription: Cococart is an e-commerce platform that makes it easy for local businesses to sell online.
company.description: Cococart is an e-commerce platform with tools for creating online stores easily with no code, no design and no app downloads. The company offers a suite of tools for online orders and reservations, marketing, payments, and fulfillment.

productsAndServices.description: A platform for local businesses to create and manage online stores to accept orders directly from customers.
productsAndServices.name: Cococart Online Store

productsAndServices.description: A mobile and tablet app for managing in-person and online sales, allowing businesses to process orders and payments on iOS and Android devices.
productsAndServices.name: Cococart Point of Sale (POS)

productsAndServices.description: A service for local businesses to accept and manage bookings and reservations through their online platform.
productsAndServices.name: Cococart Bookings

productsAndServices.description: A set of marketing features including coupon codes, customer segmentation, email promotions, and abandoned cart recovery to support local business sales growth.
productsAndServices.name: Cococart Marketing Tools

productsAndServices.description: A QR code-based ordering system that allows customers to order and pay from their smartphones at physical locations.
productsAndServices.name: Cococart Scan To Order (QR Code Menu Ordering Software)

productsAndServices.description: A loyalty program system that rewards customers with points for purchases, redeemable for discounts to encourage repeat business.
productsAndServices.name: Cococart Loyalty Program Software

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $4,100,000, or 97.04% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,902,511 to $26,045,550, a 8.97x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 85 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 60 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
